findings.reason: without naming the reconciliation (reduce the recorded arm command to the same present-file set, or resolve at run time on the prompt/dispatch side and add those paths to the write scope) an implementer ships either a gate that refuses correct pairs or a test that proves a comparison production never makes.
findings.text: s27 says the per-tree resolution is what "each arm's command" is compared against, but the arm's command is not resolved at gate time: §26 (landed, merge e6e05dcc0) resolves `{node_test_files}` once at dispatch over the node's whole write scope and states it in the worker prompt as "Run exactly this command, unedited" (`reckon/crew/prompts.py:734-738`), so `after_suite.command`/`baseline_suite.command` carry the pre-change file list, including the test the node then deletes; the gate refuses any arm whose command differs (`reckon/crew/promotion_records.py:448-457`), and s27's write paths (`reckon/crew/promotion_records.py` plus the new test) contain no place to change what the worker is told or to reduce the recorded arm command — so the node's unit test passes on resolved strings while the production path refuses a correct pair, including the incident run s27 cites

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `_node_test_files` resolves at `reckon/crew/promotion_records.py:335`; crew-state-stays-bounded §5 resolves (`docs/plans/crew-state-stays-bounded.html:110`, "Reload images live on node-local storage"); the cited run resolves and its deleted file `tests/test_a_stale_lease_record_does_not_expose_a_pin.py` is present at base 43a85b8 and absent at head 35df7afb, exactly as s27 states.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — s27 names a base arm ("The same test fails at the base") and a declared negative control ("resolving over the write paths without the presence check reproduces the exit 4 and the test fails"), and the cited incident is reproduced in run r-20261027T093350429603's own manifest (`baseline_suite` and `after_suite` both `exit_status: 4`, `completed: true`, `failure_count: 0`).
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — s27's deliverable is a repository test file, and its gate and arm logs land under the run directory through the manifest convention the other sections already use; nothing is written to a session scratchpad or node-local temp path.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the new test file is named by mechanism (`tests/test_a_scoped_suite_names_only_present_files.py`), and no plan label, stage name or ticket number reaches it.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — the root cause matches the cited evidence, but the mechanism does not run on the real code path: s27 resolves the armed command per tree at gate time, while the arm commands the gate compares are the dispatch-time resolution §26 now prints into the worker prompt and the worker records verbatim, so the change as scoped refuses the very pairs it means to accept.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — one outcome: an armed pair measures only the test files present in each arm's tree, with the empty-collection case folded in as the same outcome failing loudly rather than a second deliverable.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — s27 declares no `plan-section-depends-on` edge and needs none: its premise sections (§13 arming, §26's stored resolved command) are landed, so an edge would gate nothing; no declared relationship points at the wrong node.
